stem.text: Synthetic resins can be made by polymerisation of a variety of monomers including prop-2-en-1-ol, $\text{CH}_2\text{=CHCH}_2\text{OH}$.
Which structure represents the repeat unit in poly(prop-2-en-1-ol)?

A.alt: Repeat unit -[CH2CH2CH2O]- drawn with horizontal bonds, in brackets

B.alt: Repeat unit -[CH2-CH(CH2OH)]- drawn with CH2OH group below the chain, in brackets

C.alt: Repeat unit -[CH=C(CH2OH)]- drawn with a C=C double bond and CH2OH group below, in brackets

D.alt: Repeat unit -[CH2-CH2-CH(OH)]- drawn with OH group below the chain, in brackets
